principles: Test-first proof before full gate implementation
Do not let parent governance DONE imply child runtime completion
Keep B-5082 controls as the governance substrate rather than replacing them
Separate planning story from runtime implementation story
drivers: User explicitly asked for a detailed execution plan first
The first milestone must be red/repro tests before full story execution
The prior B-43de outcome showed story-local DONE can be correct while broader user intent remains open

options.name: A: Plan-first with red/repro milestone as M1
pros: Matches the user request for an execution plan
Makes the missing test cases explicit before runtime implementation
Can be governed by B-5082 without overclaiming implementation
cons: Does not immediately fix the runtime gap

options.name: B: Implement runtime gate immediately
pros: Would start closing the actual product gap now
cons: Skips the requested plan and test-first milestone
Risks another scope mismatch if parent/child semantics are not specified first

options.name: C: Only update B-43de summary wording
cons: Does not create a reusable gate, test plan, or cross-story totality contract

chosen: A: Plan-first with red/repro milestone as M1
rationale: The user asked for a detailed plan and clarified that red/repro tests must be the first milestone; implementation should follow only after the contract is explicit.

preMortem.scenario: The plan says test-first but later implementation skips the red tests
preMortem.trigger: M1 lacks concrete failing test names or expected failures
preMortem.consequence: The same parent-DONE overclaim can recur
preMortem.mitigation: Require M1 to name exact negative controls and expected failing assertions before any runtime gate implementation

preMortem.scenario: The plan repeats B-43de by creating only another parent ledger
preMortem.trigger: Milestones stop at documentation or parent rows
preMortem.consequence: User still cannot know when the whole roadmap is actually complete
preMortem.mitigation: Require implementation milestones for evaluator, CLI/DONE consumer, summary claim language, migration, rollout, and certification

preMortem.scenario: The gate blocks legitimate parent governance stories
preMortem.trigger: allRowsClosed is required for every parent story DONE rather than only for full-completion claims
preMortem.consequence: Planning and governance stories become impossible to close
preMortem.mitigation: Use claim-sensitive outcomes: parent governance can DONE as partial_parent_done, but cannot claim full roadmap completion
